\begin{aligned}
\mathsf{Rule}_{Q,\Pi}={}&
\{((\Gamma\vdash A\ \mathsf{type},\Gamma,x:A\vdash B\ \mathsf{type}),
\Gamma\vdash\operatorname{Pi}(x,A,B)\ \mathsf{type})\}\\
&\cup\{((\Gamma,x:A\vdash M:B),
\Gamma\vdash\operatorname{lam}(x,A,M):\operatorname{Pi}(x,A,B))\}\\
&\cup\{((\Gamma\vdash F:\operatorname{Pi}(x,A,B),\Gamma\vdash N:A),
\Gamma\vdash\operatorname{app}(F,N):B[x:=N])\}\\
&\cup\{((\Gamma,x:A\vdash M:B,\Gamma\vdash N:A),
\Gamma\vdash\operatorname{app}(\operatorname{lam}(x,A,M),N)
\equiv M[x:=N]:B[x:=N])\}.
\end{aligned}

\begin{aligned}
\mathsf{Rule}_{Q,\Sigma}={}&
\{((\Gamma\vdash A\ \mathsf{type},\Gamma,x:A\vdash B\ \mathsf{type}),
\Gamma\vdash\operatorname{Sigma}(x,A,B)\ \mathsf{type})\}\\
&\cup\{((\Gamma\vdash a:A,\Gamma\vdash b:B[x:=a]),
\Gamma\vdash\operatorname{pair}(a,b):\operatorname{Sigma}(x,A,B))\}\\
&\cup\{((\Gamma\vdash p:\operatorname{Sigma}(x,A,B)),
\Gamma\vdash\operatorname{fst}(p):A)\}\\
&\cup\{((\Gamma\vdash p:\operatorname{Sigma}(x,A,B)),
\Gamma\vdash\operatorname{snd}(p):B[x:=\operatorname{fst}(p)])\}\\
&\cup\{((\Gamma\vdash a:A,\Gamma\vdash b:B[x:=a]),
\Gamma\vdash\operatorname{fst}(\operatorname{pair}(a,b))\equiv a:A)\}\\
&\cup\{((\Gamma\vdash a:A,\Gamma\vdash b:B[x:=a]),
\Gamma\vdash\operatorname{snd}(\operatorname{pair}(a,b))\equiv b:B[x:=a])\}.
\end{aligned}

\begin{aligned}
\mathsf{Rule}_{Q,\operatorname{Id}}={}&
\{((\Gamma\vdash A\ \mathsf{type},\Gamma\vdash a:A,\Gamma\vdash b:A),
\Gamma\vdash\operatorname{Id}(A,a,b)\ \mathsf{type})\}\\
&\cup\{((\Gamma\vdash a:A),
\Gamma\vdash\operatorname{refl}(a):\operatorname{Id}(A,a,a))\}\\
&\cup\{((\Gamma\vdash p:\operatorname{Id}(A,a,b),
\Gamma,u:A,v:A,q:\operatorname{Id}(A,u,v)\vdash C\ \mathsf{type},
\Gamma,u:A\vdash d:C[v:=u][q:=\operatorname{refl}(u)]),
\Gamma\vdash\operatorname{J}(u.v.q.C,d,a,b,p):C[u:=a][v:=b][q:=p])\}\\
&\cup\{((\Gamma\vdash a:A,
\Gamma,u:A,v:A,q:\operatorname{Id}(A,u,v)\vdash C\ \mathsf{type},
\Gamma,u:A\vdash d:C[v:=u][q:=\operatorname{refl}(u)]),
\Gamma\vdash\operatorname{J}(u.v.q.C,d,a,a,\operatorname{refl}(a))
\equiv d[u:=a]:C[u:=a][v:=a][q:=\operatorname{refl}(a)])\}.
\end{aligned}

\begin{aligned}
\mathsf{Rule}_{Q,\mathsf{Eq}}={}&
\{((\Gamma\vdash a:A),\Gamma\vdash a\equiv a:A)\}\\
&\cup\{((\Gamma\vdash a\equiv b:A),\Gamma\vdash b\equiv a:A)\}\\
&\cup\{((\Gamma\vdash a\equiv b:A,\Gamma\vdash b\equiv c:A),
\Gamma\vdash a\equiv c:A)\}\\
&\cup\{((\Gamma\vdash a:A),\Gamma\vdash a\equiv b:A):a\equiv_\alpha^{Q}b\},
